mood: Premium fintech, Caribbean nightlife, Black-Excellence, Confident, Gold-forward

matte_black.usage: Backgrounds, deep cards, primary structural elements

metallic_gold.usage: Primary CTAs, focus rings, highlight indicators, balance amounts, premium filigree

white.usage: Primary text on dark backgrounds, card backgrounds in light mode

neon_cyan.usage: Secondary accent, hover glows, live-update pulses (sparingly, e.g., driver moving, live order status)

motion_guidance.hover_glow: Primary buttons should transition smoothly to a larger, brighter gold shadow (`shadow-gold-glow-lg`) on hover.
motion_guidance.live_indicators: Any live status (driver map marker, order processing) should use the `animate-pulse-cyan` keyframe to throb softly with a cyan glow.
motion_guidance.cards: Interactive cards should lift slightly on hover (`-translate-y-1`) with an increased drop shadow (`shadow-card-hover`).

migration_checklist.step_1_tailwind: Update `tailwind.config.js` to include the new colors (matte, gold, neon), fontFamily, backgroundImage, and boxShadow extensions.
migration_checklist.step_2_css: Replace the content of `index.css` `:root` and `.dark` blocks with the new HSL variables. Ensure the Google Fonts `@import` is at the top of `index.css`.
migration_checklist.step_3_force_dark: Set the default theme to dark by adding the `dark` class to the HTML or body tag by default, or configuring the theme provider to default to dark.
step_4_find_replace_colors: Find `bg-blue-*`, `bg-indigo-*`, `bg-teal-*` and replace with `bg-primary` or `bg-gold-500` depending on context.
Ensure backgrounds use `bg-background` for pages and `bg-card` for elevated surfaces instead of hardcoded `bg-gray-*`.
migration_checklist.step_5_typography: Replace `font-sans` with `font-heading` on all `h1`, `h2`, `h3` tags to apply Outfit. Ensure body text relies on the default `font-sans` (Manrope).
step_6_components: Update Shadcn `Button` component variations in `components/ui/button.tsx` to use the new `bg-gold-gradient` for the `default` variant.
Update Shadcn `Card` component to use the new border colors.
Update Shadcn `Badge` to include a `live` variant with `bg-neon-cyan/20` and `animate-pulse-cyan`.
migration_checklist.step_7_data_testid: Verify all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links) have a `data-testid` attribute using kebab-case role-based naming (e.g., `data-testid="checkout-pay-button"`).

hero_abstract_gold.description: Abstract 3D metallic gold waves over matte black background. Use for marketing landing page hero background.

wallet_card_premium.description: Sleek matte black credit card with metallic gold edges. Use for Wallet deposit/balance visual or marketing page.

lifestyle_car.description: Black luxury car on cobblestone. Use for 'Drive with Us' / Partner CTA section.
